title: Martial Arts Instructor-Trainer (MGySgt to Sgt) FMOS, CG TECOM
raw_text:
6.     MOS 0917, Martial Arts Instructor-Trainer (MGySgt to Sgt) FMOS, CG TECOM

    a. Summary. Martial Arts Instructor Trainers train and certify martial
arts instructors. Additionally, they provide instruction to all personnel in
hand-held weapons, unarmed against hand-held weapons, weapons of opportunity,
ground fighting, firearm disarmament, and principles of core values.

       b.   Prerequisites

            (1) Must have recommendation of reporting senior.

            (2) Must be certified as a green belt or above in the MCMAP.

            (3) Must have completed the appropriate level PME for grade.

            (4) Must be sergeant or above.   This prerequisite is non-waiverable.

            (5) Must qualify with a minimum of first class score on the PFT and
CFT.

        (6) Must have a minimum of 1 year obligated service upon completion
of MAITC.

        (7) Full duty status shoulder injury free in previous 2 years,
concussion free within the past 6 months and free of contagious diseases or
dermatological conditions.

    c. Requirements. Successful completion of the Martial Arts Instructor-
Trainer Course (M02MMKT) at The Basic School at Quantico, VA.

       d.   Duties

        (1) Trains and certifies personnel in martial arts techniques from
tan through 1st degree black belt and trains personnel in martial arts
techniques from 2nd through 4th degree black belt.

        (2) Trains, certifies, and recertifies martial arts instructors under
the CG, TRNGCOM approved Martial Arts Instructor Program of Instruction for
Martial Arts Instructors.



                                          3-94                        Enclosure (1)
 3115                                                                   NAVMC 1200.1L



    e. Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code.
Teachers and Instructors, All Other 25-3099.

       f.   Related Military Skill.   Martial Arts Instructor, 0916.

Occupational Field 09, Training, comprises MOSs used to identify Marines who possess skill sets to conduct vital training, particularly to entry-level Marines, as required by various high visibility Marine Corps programs. First exposure to Marine Corps training is provided by the Drill Instructor. (6) Must have a minimum of 1 year obligated service upon completion of MAITC. (7) Full duty status shoulder injury free in previous 2 years, concussion free within the past 6 months and free of contagious diseases or dermatological conditions. c. Requirements. Successful completion of the Martial Arts Instructor- Trainer Course (M02MMKT) at The Basic School at Quantico, VA. d. Duties (1) Trains and certifies personnel in martial arts techniques from tan through 1st degree black belt and trains personnel in martial arts techniques from 2nd through 4th degree black belt. nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade. Summary compares non-future individual source entries (versions can repeat) with nonempty reference sets; grouped, future and general-standard entries remain in all outputs. Hit@k is the fraction with at least one reference SOC recovered; ties are averaged exactly. References outside NLx remain in denominators. DMDC reference status is from July 2024, not current 2026 status.
